The architecture, domain, QA, and risk outputs align on a Rust 2024 Axum backend in backend/, a Next.js App Router TypeScript frontend in frontend/, SQLite/sqlx persistence, server-side OpenRouter proxying, mocked provider tests, placeholder-only environment examples, and final verification gates.

raw.summary: Planning is actionable for gpt-copy-v7 with no material ambiguity. The architecture, domain, QA, and risk outputs align on a Rust 2024 Axum backend in backend/, a Next.js App Router TypeScript frontend in frontend/, SQLite/sqlx persistence, server-side OpenRouter proxying, mocked provider tests, placeholder-only environment examples, and final verification gates.

proposals.title: Proceed to dependency-aware task splitting
proposals.summary: Split the work into root hygiene/docs, backend foundation, backend persistence and JSON routes, OpenRouter provider abstraction, SSE streaming, frontend scaffold/API client, ChatGPT-style UI, native streaming integration, mocked Playwright smoke, and final QA verification.

proposals.title: Stabilize backend contracts before frontend streaming
proposals.summary: Implement backend DTOs, structured error shape, validation codes, conversation/message routes, and SSE event semantics before frontend integration depends on them.

proposals.title: Keep provider testing mock-only
proposals.summary: Require ChatProvider injection and mocked tests for OpenRouter success, missing configuration, 429, timeout, invalid payload, streaming success, and interrupted streams so automated checks never call external providers.

proposals.title: Verify frontend/backend schema alignment
proposals.summary: Mirror backend response and error contracts in zod schemas, surface malformed response failures in the UI, and keep Playwright fixtures aligned with the same contract.

risks.title: OpenRouter secret or provider endpoint leaks to browser
risks.impact: Client-side provider access would expose credentials or violate the required server-side proxy boundary.
risks.mitigation: Keep OPENROUTER_API_KEY and OPENROUTER_MODEL only in backend runtime config, expose only NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL to frontend code, and add Playwright plus grep checks for OpenRouter leakage.

risks.title: Streaming interruption persists partial assistant output
risks.impact: Conversation history could be corrupted if interrupted streams save incomplete assistant messages.
risks.mitigation: Persist the user message before streaming, accumulate assistant deltas in memory, persist the assistant only after provider completion, emit SSE error events on interruption, and test the interrupted path with mocks.

risks.title: Automated tests accidentally depend on live OpenRouter
risks.impact: Verification would become flaky, consume quota, or require local secrets.
risks.mitigation: Use provider trait mocks or local fake responses in backend tests and fully mocked backend routes in frontend and Playwright tests.

risks.title: Backend and frontend contracts drift
risks.impact: The frontend may pass tests against stale fixtures while failing against actual Axum responses.
risks.mitigation: Schedule backend DTO and error work before frontend client integration, validate every backend response with zod, and test malformed response handling.

risks.title: Generated artifacts or local secrets are tracked
risks.impact: Final approval would be blocked by committed databases, build outputs, test reports, node_modules, or real OpenRouter keys.
risks.mitigation: Add root hygiene early and require final git grep plus git ls-files checks before CodeDungeon finalization.

claims.title: No user input required
claims.summary: The prompt, approved project rules, and prior planner outputs define sufficient scope, boundaries, verification commands, and failure contracts for task splitting and implementation.

claims.title: Backend-first contract sequencing
claims.summary: Backend validation, DTOs, error mapping, provider abstraction, and SSE event semantics should be stable before frontend streaming and Playwright smoke depend on them.

claims.title: Provider access is server-only
claims.summary: All OpenRouter calls must stay under backend/ and use OPENROUTER_API_KEY plus OPENROUTER_MODEL from backend runtime configuration.

claims.title: Automated provider behavior is mocked
claims.summary: Backend, frontend, and Playwright tests must not call external providers unless the user explicitly changes the project rules.

claims.title: Completion depends on verification evidence
claims.summary: Final reporting should wait for backend fmt, clippy, tests, frontend lint, tests, build, Playwright smoke, secret scan, generated-artifact scan, and CodeDungeon review/finalization gates.
